stage: stationary noiseless baseline; no dynamic sweep
source_moment_note: Fixed ideal excitation. Magnitude follows current R4-C1 10 A estimate, not a new calibration. Polarity follows archived source-axis convention. Pose recovery should be invariant to nonzero independent source scaling.
source_geometry_rule: Frozen arithmetic mean positions and normalized mean tracked +z axes from the ten archived Fig.6 records, matching existing provenance.
target_rule: All ten archived target poses, each tested independently as a stationary pose; not interpreted as a continuous trajectory.

timing.CV_rule: Nominal reproduction of the reported common 3.47 Hz CV schedule: 4 x 72 ms. 60 ms scheduled wait, then 12 ms budget; fewer active sensors leave padding. This is a stated schedule assumption, not a verified firmware trace.
timing.CC_rule: Nominal rule from data/experiment_details.md: Tslot=20 ms + N/1000, 3 slots. Only the fastest 3-sensor 14.49 Hz case is explicitly reported in the main text.
timing.sample_phase_rule: Point sample at the midpoint of each 1 ms sensor window, selected sensor IDs in ascending order. Integration aperture, read order and firmware clock alignment are unverified. Static baseline does not depend on these choices.
timing.reference_rule: Reported acquisition end is final source sensor-window end. Full-cycle end (including CV background/padding) is stored separately. No host computation or transmission delay included.

idealization.current_transient_model: Settled source field only; wait times remain in the schedule. Switching transients and residual fields are excluded.

model_notes.point_dipole_full_array: Primary noiseless baseline. Exact point-dipole field at every physical sensor offset; finite-array gradient approximation remains.
model_notes.matched_local_linear: Algebraic control only. Use analytic center field and gradient to synthesize b + X d, then the same estimator. Removes spatial Taylor truncation as well as external errors. Not exact finite-array field sampling.
